first_statistical_study.suite: Official NIST STS2.1.2, unmodified algorithms/default parameters
first_statistical_study.scope: Host OS entropy; frozen production provider with independently reviewed mechanical API/configuration port to final source. Does not measure physical ESP32 entropy or prove cryptographic security/approval/RTP.
first_statistical_study.current_source_basis: The statistical sample belongs to the unchanged production AES-256 CTR-DRBG provider. Current UI/audio changes do not constitute a new physical-device entropy or statistical study.

source_tests.scope: Known-answer, bounded-draw, entropy/reentry/exhaustion and Engine failure tests; deterministic entropy injection enabled only for tests.

native_validation.validation_scope: Current106 firmware/assets full readback and healthy fresh startup. Native play and acoustic onset were not measured by this flash check.
